note: Riverside County regional park below the Santa Rosa Mountains outside La Quinta, on the south shore of a canal-fed reservoir with fishing but no swimming or inflatables. Palm-shaded RV loop beside open sand by the shore; a pool and lawns in the day-use area. Summer heat is severe and the camper gate closes at 2 p.m. from May to October (gate code given to reservations). A sheriff's gun range is nearby. --Claude

WATERFRONT LEAD (lakeview kept, not raised): in imagery the RV loop's north, lake-side road has a row of pads on its lake side with only open sand ~15-30 m wide between them and the reservoir's grey bank strip (e.g. pad ~33.62682,-116.27027, high-water edge ~33.62698,-116.27027, ~18 m). On the not-to-scale brochure map that row is roughly sites 66-71 and the even numbers 40-60, with 35-39 round the east end. Against raising it: the brochure marks that sand as 'Dry Campground' (first-come dry camping), so the strip may count as used ground; the site numbers can't be pinned without the booking site; and the bank strip at the shore looks like riprap or a track. The dry campground on the sand flat at the lake's south-east tip is itself next to the water, but it has no named sites. Needs AWH's call, or a booking-site read with site positions.

SITES: stored count 120 (note prose) -> 107 (county features: 62 hookup + 10 water-only + 35 dry individual; the 20 equestrian/group sites in their own corral loop are left out). The page's intro says '96 individual and group campsites', which matches neither total.
